Motorcyclist killed in Fresno crash

A motorcyclist was killed Saturday morning in a collision with a pickup truck on Highway 99 in Fresno, the California Highway Patrol said.

The crash happened shortly after 6 a.m. near the Clinton Avenue exit. The rider was pronounced dead at the scene, according to the CHP.

The cause of the crash is under investigation, officers said. The driver of the pickup stayed at the scene and was cooperating with investigators.
